body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/36599

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/1138

## What changed

- Moved the legacy DeepSeek `modelopt_fp4` NextN-to-BF16 decision from the shared `DeepseekModelNextN` constructor into the DeepSeek wrapper's quant-config resolver.
- Kept `modelopt_fp4` for GLM-5.3 NextN when the checkpoint does not declare the whole NextN layer unquantized.
- Preserved BF16 NextN construction for DeepSeek ModelOpt FP4 checkpoints and checkpoint-excluded GLM NextN layers.
- Added a direct constructor regression plus independent model/config boundary cases.

## Reproduction and validation

The failing-before regression constructs the actual `DeepseekModelNextN` implementation with its heavyweight dependencies mocked and observes the quant config passed to `DeepseekV2DecoderLayer`. At the recorded base, the decoder receives `None`; after this change it receives the GLM draft's `modelopt_fp4` config.

```text
PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-fadd43cfc17a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/models/test_nextn_quant_config.py
5 passed

PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-fadd43cfc17a/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_modelopt_loader.py::TestModelOptFp4LoaderSelection::test_draft_modelopt_fp4_uses_checkpoint_exclusions test/registered/unit/model_loader/test_modelopt_loader.py::TestModelOptFp4LoaderSelection::test_unquantized_modelopt_fp4_preserves_modelopt_workflows
2 passed, 6 subtests passed
```

Raw outputs and the structured result are under `reports/j-fadd43cfc17a/` (raw logs remain in the prepared worktree's evidence directory).

## Limitations

- No GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 weights were available locally, so this does not claim a full checkpoint load or speculative-serving run.
- The reported workload uses two NVIDIA DGX Spark nodes (SM121, TP2/EP2, Marlin). The assigned device is one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950, and this checkout explicitly rejects `modelopt_fp4` on ROCm, so no GPU execution is claimed.
- The tiny Llama fixture is not architecture- or quantization-equivalent and was not used as a substitute.
- Open upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37322 was inspected. It proposes a broader cross-model exclusion-mapping solution; this PR intentionally limits itself to the demonstrated shared-constructor/GLM dispatch defect.
